assumptions: Loads are quasi-static. Inertia, friction, seal drag, and line pressure drop are not included.
Gravity is 9.81 m/s² along −Z. Mass is volume times the material density, plus payload_kg at payload_at or at the center of mass.
A revolute torque is the moment of supported weight about the joint axis, in N·m. A prismatic force is the opposing component of that weight along the slide.
A gear or linkage reflects the driven load onto the driver when the driven joint has no actuator. Ratio is d(driven)/d(driver).
A hydraulic cylinder turns torque into force with moment_arm_mm. Pressure is force over piston area. Extend uses the bore; retract uses bore minus rod.
Flow is area times the speed of the piston. Power is pressure times flow divided by efficiency. 1 MPa · mm³/s = 0.001 W.

An electric motor torque is the joint torque divided by gear ratio and efficiency. Current is that torque divided by the torque constant. Power is joint torque times speed, divided by efficiency. Braking energy is counted as spent, not regenerated.
Battery energy is the sum of electric actuator energy. Charge is that energy divided by the stated voltage.

first_pattern.note: High loosening risk. The plates can slip or the joint can separate. A stronger bolt does not fix slip. The clamp and a locking feature do.

slew_pattern.note: Low loosening risk for the stated loads. A drilling rig still wants a locking feature, because embedment and shock are not in this static margin.

coupon.note: mild steel: peak von Mises 344 MPa, minimum safety factor 0.73, peak displacement 0.0335 mm. Design review: fail at a target safety factor of 2.

upper.note: mild steel: peak von Mises 60 MPa, minimum safety factor 4.16, peak displacement 0.217 mm. Design review: pass at a target safety factor of 2.

suggestions: Mode 1 at 9.49 Hz is within 5% of HQ drill 600 rpm harmonic 1 at 10.00 Hz. The mode is just below the excitation. Stiffening raises it past the excitation. Adding mass drops it further away. A shorter span or a taller section is the usual stiffening. Changing the running speed moves the excitation instead.

Mode 2 at 9.50 Hz is within 5% of HQ drill 600 rpm harmonic 1 at 10.00 Hz. The mode is just below the excitation. Stiffening raises it past the excitation. Adding mass drops it further away. A shorter span or a taller section is the usual stiffening. Changing the running speed moves the excitation instead.
